verdict.rationale: The evidence shows llamafile has an HTTP server with an API and Web UI (llamafile-docs-9, llamafile-docs-5), but nothing documents token streaming to a client application, such as SSE or a stream parameter. A community note that it 'emits a token every five or six seconds' describes observed generation speed, not a programmatic streaming API, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream generated tokens back to my application as they are produced
